title: Citrix DaaS - Connection & Sessions
description: End-to-end Citrix DaaS flow dashboard: connection failures and reasons, connection/session performance degradation, and application connection and underlying machine performance, correlated from connection through session to the hosting machine.

definition.content:
### Overview
This dashboard consolidates connection failures and their reasons, session/connection performance degradation, and application connection and underlying machine performance into a single view.

### Tips
- Use the timeframe selector in the top right to change the default timeframe.
- Use template variables to filter by machine, user, desktop group, connection, session, failure type, application, or tenant.
- Clone this dashboard to rearrange, modify, and add widgets.

## Widgets
  1. Total Connections
  2. Total Sessions
  3. Connection Failure Rate
  4. Session Failure Rate
  5. Connections vs Sessions Over Time
  6. Total Connection Failures
  7. Connection Failures Over Time by Failure Type
  8. Unencrypted (Non-Secure ICA) Connections
  9. Connection Failures by Type
  10. Top Machines by Connection Failures
  11. Top Users Affected by Connection Failures
  12. Total Failed Sessions
  13. Session Failures Over Time by Type
  14. Anonymous Sessions
  15. Top Machines by Session Failure Rate
  16. Top Affected Users by Failed Sessions
  17. Avg Logon Duration
  18. Avg Authentication Duration
  19. Avg ICA Round Trip Time
  20. Avg Session Duration
  21. Logon Duration Over Time (Avg)
  22. Authentication Duration Over Time
  23. ICA Round Trip Time Trend
  24. Client vs Server Latency per Machine
  25. Connection Details
  26. Session Details

definition.title: Total Connections
definition.description: Total number of connection attempts in the selected timeframe — the entry point of the Citrix DaaS flow.

definition.title: Total Sessions
definition.description: Total number of sessions created from those connections — one connection can carry multiple sessions.

definition.title: Connection Failure Rate
definition.description: Percentage of connections that resulted in an active failure (excludes None/Unknown). Green <5%, yellow 5-10%, red ≥10%.

definition.title: Session Failure Rate
definition.description: Percentage of sessions that ended with a non-zero exit code. Green <5%, yellow 5-10%, red ≥10%.

definition.title: Total Connection Failures
definition.description: Count of connections with an active failure type (excludes None and Unknown). Non-zero values warrant investigation.

definition.title: Connection Failures Over Time
definition.description: Trend of connection failures broken down by named failure type (from @cds.citrix_daas.connection.failure_type). Correlate spikes with infrastructure events or maintenance windows.

definition.title: Unencrypted (Non-Secure ICA) Connections
definition.description: Connections established without ICA encryption. A security and reliability risk on untrusted networks.

definition.title: Connection Failures by Type
definition.description: Distribution of connection failures across named failure types — pinpoints the dominant root cause.

definition.title: Top Machines by Connection Failures
definition.description: Machines with the highest connection failure count. Persistent presence indicates a VDA-level problem requiring targeted remediation.

definition.title: Top Users Affected by Connection Failures
definition.description: Users experiencing the most connection failures. High repeat counts suggest a client-side or profile-level issue.

definition.title: Total Failed Sessions
definition.description: Sessions that ended with a non-zero exit code in the selected timeframe.

definition.title: Session Failures Over Time
definition.description: Trend of failed sessions grouped by failure type (same failure taxonomy as connections) — reveals spikes and recurring failure patterns.

definition.title: Anonymous Sessions
definition.description: Sessions launched without an authenticated user identity.

definition.title: Top Machines by Session Failure Rate
definition.description: Ranks machines by failure rate (failed / total sessions) — pinpoints machines with systemic session issues for targeted remediation.

definition.title: Top Affected Users by Failed Sessions
definition.description: Identifies users experiencing the most session failures — prioritizes user-facing escalations and helpdesk triage.

definition.title: Avg Logon Duration
definition.description: Average time (connection logon) users wait before a connection is established.

definition.title: Avg Authentication Duration
definition.description: Average time spent authenticating during connection logon.

definition.title: Avg ICA Round Trip Time
definition.description: Average round-trip time of the ICA protocol across active sessions — the primary indicator of interactive responsiveness.

definition.title: Avg Session Duration
definition.description: Average session completion time across all sessions in scope.

definition.title: Logon Duration Over Time (Avg)
definition.description: Overall connection logon performance trend — sustained increases indicate broker, VDA, or infrastructure degradation.

definition.title: Authentication Duration Over Time
definition.description: Trend of connection authentication time — sustained increases point to identity provider or broker latency.

definition.title: ICA Round Trip Time Trend
definition.description: ICA RTT trend across sessions, with warning/critical thresholds matching the shipped RTT monitor.

definition.title: Client vs Server Latency per Machine
definition.description: Per-machine client latency, server latency, and ICA RTT side by side — isolates whether degradation is network- or machine-side.

definition.title: Avg CPU Utilization Over Time by Machine
definition.description: CPU utilization trend for the top machines running the selected application.

definition.title: Avg Memory Usage Over Time by Machine
definition.description: Used memory as a percentage of total memory over time for the top machines running the selected application.

definition.title: Connection Details
definition.description: Detailed view of individual connection events for investigation and troubleshooting.
